children.text:
• Open: Main Menu hub tile "Character", key C, or tap a slot on the HUD later.
• Left: avatar preview (ViewportFrame, drag to spin) wearing the current rod; tap an equipped slot to jump to its tab.
• Right: only OWNED items. Coral tick = equipped, blue border = selected. Last cell "+" opens the Shop on that tab.
• Detail compares the selected item with the equipped one (name in rarity colour, mint = better). EQUIP swaps instantly; equipped item shows EQUIPPED.
• Baits show the stack count; the bait slot can also be emptied (UNEQUIP).
• Aura stays in the Auras window (its own equip flow).
